result.instructions: Tools for FreeAgent, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes FreeAgent data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run freeagent_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run freeagent_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run freeagent_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. freeagent_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: freeagent_get_company
tools.title: Get the company
tools.description: Fetch the FreeAgent company these credentials belong to — name, type (e.g. UkLimitedCompany), currency, start date and VAT registration status. A cheap way to confirm the setup works. FreeAgent: GET /v2/company.

tools.name: freeagent_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Fetch the FreeAgent user the token acts as, including their URL (needed for freeagent_create_timeslip) and permission level. FreeAgent: GET /v2/users/me.

tools.name: freeagent_get_tax_timeline
tools.title: Get the tax timeline
tools.description: List upcoming tax deadlines and amounts due — VAT returns, corporation tax, self assessment and so on. FreeAgent: GET /v2/company/tax_timeline.

tools.name: freeagent_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (clients and suppliers), with their account balance. FreeAgent: GET /v2/contacts.

view.description: Filter (default active). open_clients = clients with unpaid invoices.

sort.description: Sort order; a leading - means descending.

updated_since.description: Only records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

tools.name: freeagent_get_contact
tools.title: Get one contact
tools.description: Fetch a single contact by id or URL. FreeAgent: GET /v2/contacts/:id.

contact.description: The contact's numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

tools.name: freeagent_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices, optionally for one contact or project, filtered by status. FreeAgent: GET /v2/invoices.

view.description: Filter: all, recent_open_or_overdue, open, overdue, open_or_overdue, draft, paid, scheduled_to_email, thank_you_emails, reminder_emails, or last_N_months (e.g. last_3_months).

sort.description: Sort order (default created_at); a leading - means descending.

contact.description: Only for this contact — its numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

project.description: Only for this project — its numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

updated_since.description: Only records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

tools.name: freeagent_get_invoice
tools.title: Get one invoice
tools.description: Fetch a single invoice by id or URL, with its line items, totals, due and paid values. FreeAgent: GET /v2/invoices/:id.

invoice.description: The invoice's numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

tools.name: freeagent_list_bills
tools.title: List bills
tools.description: List supplier bills (purchases), optionally by date range, contact or project, filtered by status. FreeAgent: GET /v2/bills.

updated_since.description: Only records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

contact.description: Only for this contact — its numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

project.description: Only for this project — its numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

tools.name: freeagent_list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses
tools.description: List expense claims (out-of-pocket spending and mileage), optionally by date range or project. FreeAgent: GET /v2/expenses.

updated_since.description: Only records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

project.description: Only for this project — its numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

tools.name: freeagent_list_bank_accounts
tools.title: List bank accounts
tools.description: List bank, credit-card and PayPal accounts with their current balances. Use an account's URL with freeagent_list_bank_transactions. FreeAgent: GET /v2/bank_accounts.

tools.name: freeagent_list_bank_transactions
tools.title: List bank transactions
tools.description: List the transactions on one bank account, e.g. view=unexplained for what still needs reconciling. FreeAgent: GET /v2/bank_transactions?bank_account=….

bank_account.description: The bank account's numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

view.description: Filter (default all). unexplained = not yet reconciled.

updated_since.description: Only records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

last_uploaded.description: Only transactions from the latest statement upload.

tools.name: freeagent_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects, optionally for one contact. FreeAgent: GET /v2/projects.

sort.description: Sort order; a leading - means descending.

contact.description: Only for this contact — its numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

nested.description: Embed the related contact instead of its URL.

tools.name: freeagent_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List project tasks with their billing rates, optionally for one project. A task's URL is needed for freeagent_create_timeslip. FreeAgent: GET /v2/tasks.

project.description: Only for this project — its numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

updated_since.description: Only records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

tools.name: freeagent_list_timeslips
tools.title: List timeslips
tools.description: List logged time, optionally by date range, user, task or project; view=unbilled for time not yet invoiced. FreeAgent: GET /v2/timeslips.

updated_since.description: Only records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

user.description: Only for this user — its numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

task.description: Only for this task — its numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

project.description: Only for this project — its numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

nested.description: Embed related user, task and project instead of URLs.

tools.name: freeagent_get_profit_and_loss
tools.title: Get profit and loss
tools.description: Profit and loss summary — income, expenses, operating and retained profit — for a date range or an accounting period (defaults to the current year to date). FreeAgent: GET /v2/accounting/profit_and_loss/summary.

accounting_period.description: An accounting year instead of dates, e.g. 2025/26.

tools.name: freeagent_get_balance_sheet
tools.title: Get the balance sheet
tools.description: Balance sheet — capital and current assets, liabilities and owners' equity — as at a date (default today). FreeAgent: GET /v2/accounting/balance_sheet.

tools.name: freeagent_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a client or supplier contact. Give either organisation_name, or first_name and last_name. FreeAgent: POST /v2/contacts.

billing_email.description: Email address invoices are sent to.

contact_name_on_invoices.description: Show the contact's name on invoices.

default_payment_terms_in_days.description: Default payment terms for invoices to this contact.

tools.name: freeagent_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Update fields on an existing contact; only the fields you pass change. status=Hidden hides it (reversible with Active). FreeAgent: PUT /v2/contacts/:id.

contact.description: The contact's numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

billing_email.description: Email address invoices are sent to.

contact_name_on_invoices.description: Show the contact's name on invoices.

default_payment_terms_in_days.description: Default payment terms for invoices to this contact.

tools.name: freeagent_create_draft_invoice
tools.title: Create a draft invoice
tools.description: Create a sales invoice in DRAFT status. Nothing is sent to the customer and nothing is posted as income until it is marked sent in FreeAgent; a draft can be edited or discarded there. FreeAgent: POST /v2/invoices.

contact.description: The contact being invoiced's numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

payment_terms_in_days.description: Payment terms in days; 0 = due on receipt.

due_on.description: Explicit due date, if not derived from payment terms (YYYY-MM-DD).

reference.description: Invoice reference/number; omit to use the next in sequence.

currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. GBP (defaults to the company currency).

exchange_rate.description: Exchange rate for a foreign-currency invoice.

project.description: The project's numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

item_type.description: Unit type of the line (e.g. Hours, Days, Services, Products).

price.description: Unit price, in the invoice currency (required for non time-based items).

sales_tax_rate.description: VAT rate percentage for this line, e.g. 20.

tools.name: freeagent_create_timeslip
tools.title: Log a timeslip
tools.description: Log time against a project task for a user. Get the user from freeagent_get_current_user and the task from freeagent_list_tasks. Editable or removable in FreeAgent afterwards. FreeAgent: POST /v2/timeslips.

user.description: The user's numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

project.description: The project's numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

task.description: The task's numeric id or full FreeAgent URL.

comment.description: What the time was spent on.
